title: USAspending.gov API (federal awards and spending)
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
questions: which companies received the most federal contracts
federal spending by state per capita
grants from an agency over time
how much did an agency obligate in a fiscal year

manual.how: Run download_data.sh (macOS, Linux) or download_data.ps1 (Windows) from manual_download/ with one command (no Python needed): the search endpoints are POST requests, which a browser cannot open; GET links (agency, budgetary resources, recipient state, award) also open in a browser (save each under the name shown). Upload the files, then --ingest. Without the bundle: on https://www.usaspending.gov/search set the filters (time period as fiscal years, award type, agency, location, keyword) and use Download > Award or Transaction CSV, or Advanced Search > the tab for the breakdown (e.g. Spending by Category) and its table download; upload the CSV and say which view it is.

cache.why: The database is updated nightly and award records are revised; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: USAspending data are published by the U.S. Treasury under the DATA Act (31 U.S.C. 6101 note); they are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). Recipient names and amounts are public records; cite USAspending.gov as the source.

citation: U.S. Department of the Treasury, USAspending.gov, {dataset}, api.usaspending.gov (API v2), retrieved {retrieved_long}.

audit_hooks.why: USAspending periods are federal fiscal years (October-September); the report must say so before comparing with calendar-year data.

clarify: Federal fiscal years (October-September, the API's basis) or calendar years? Converting needs monthly data (over_time with group=month).

Obligations (commitments made, what the search endpoints sum) or outlays (cash paid out, from agency budgetary resources or award outlays)? They differ by year and can differ a lot for multi-year awards and loans.
Which award types: contracts, grants, loans (face value, not cost), direct payments, or all? Award searches take one type group at a time.
